name: Potions
descriptionTemplate:
Gain 1 stack of {overlay:Boiling Anger}.
Effects differ based on the type of Potion concocted:
{Creekwort Potion}: Draw 2 cards.
{Beadlily Potion}: Gain 2 Arithmetica.
{Howlberry Potion}: All Awakeners gain 10 Fixed Aliemus.
A chosen ingredient is removed from Vivian's stock until all ingredients have been chosen, then the stock resets.
